blocks.en: Hacking is used to access Container structures in relic and data sites, chemical labs as well as mission given by Agents.
blocks.zh: 破解（Hacking）用于打开遗迹和数据站点、化学实验室以及代理人任务中的容器建筑。

blocks.en: Hacking
blocks.zh: 破解

blocks.en: The hacking mini-game with systems indications.
blocks.zh: 破解小游戏及各系统标识。

blocks.en: The goal of hacking is to find and disable the Container’s System Core. You do this by maneuvering a Virus through the board of nodes that represents the Container’s electronics.
blocks.zh: 破解的目标是找到并瘫痪容器的系统核心（System Core）。方法是操纵一个病毒在代表容器电子系统的节点棋盘上移动。

blocks.en: Nodes are:
blocks.zh: 节点的颜色：

en: orange if explored
green if adjacent to explored nodes
gray if neither explored or adjacent to explored nodes
zh: 橙色：已探索
绿色：与已探索节点相邻
灰色：既未探索，也不与已探索节点相邻

blocks.en: Clicking on a green node will reveal its contents: if the node is empty, it will turn orange and allow you to further explore adjacent nodes.
blocks.zh: 点击绿色节点会揭示其内容：如果节点是空的，它会变成橙色，你就可以继续探索与它相邻的节点。

blocks.en: If the new node is empty it will briefly display a number between 1 and 5. The number is the distance to the nearest node with a System Core, Utility Subsystem or Data Cache.
blocks.zh: 如果新节点是空的，它会短暂显示一个 1 到 5 之间的数字。这个数字表示到最近的系统核心、功能子系统或数据缓存的距离。

blocks.en: Number:
blocks.zh: 数字含义：

en: 1 means an adjacent node is a System Core, Utility Subsystem or Data Cache
2, 3 and 4 mean the nearest System Core, Utility Subsystem or Data Cache is respectively 2, 3 and 4 nodes away
5 means you are 5 or more nodes away from the nearest System Core, Utility Subsystem or Data Cache
zh: 1 表示相邻节点中有系统核心、功能子系统或数据缓存
2、3、4 分别表示最近的系统核心、功能子系统或数据缓存在 2、3、4 个节点之外
5 表示你离最近的系统核心、功能子系统或数据缓存有 5 个或更多节点

blocks.en: The numbers 1-5 don't tell you how distant you are from the nearest Defensive Subsystem.
blocks.zh: 数字 1-5 不会告诉你离最近的防御子系统有多远。

blocks.en: Instead of being empty, a node may contain:
blocks.zh: 节点里除了空的，还可能有：

en: a System Core
a Defensive Subsystem
a Utility Subsystem
a Data Cache
zh: 系统核心
防御子系统
功能子系统
数据缓存

blocks.en: System Core
blocks.zh: 系统核心

blocks.en: Finding and disabling the System Core is the goal of hacking.
blocks.zh: 找到并瘫痪系统核心就是破解的目标。

blocks.en: System Cores, Defensive Subsystems and your Virus have:
blocks.zh: 系统核心、防御子系统和你的病毒都有：

en: Coherence () which is their health
Strength () which is their attack power
zh: 连贯性（Coherence）（），即它们的生命值
强度（Strength）（），即它们的攻击力

blocks.en: When you click on the System Core or Defensive Subsystem your Virus will attack. Attacking is turn-based:
blocks.zh: 点击系统核心或防御子系统时，你的病毒就会发起攻击。攻击是回合制的：

en: your Virus attacks, lowering the System's Coherence by your Virus Strength; and then
the System Core or Defensive Subsystem retaliates if it survived the attack.
zh: 你的病毒发起攻击，按病毒强度降低对方的连贯性；然后
如果系统核心或防御子系统在攻击中幸存，它会进行反击。

blocks.en: When you reduce the System's Coherence to 0, it is disabled and removed from the board.
blocks.zh: 当你把对方的连贯性降到 0 时，它就会被瘫痪并从棋盘上移除。

blocks.en: You fail a hack when:
blocks.zh: 以下情况会导致破解失败：

en: your Virus Coherence reaches 0
the hacking window is closed for any reason, such as moving too far away from the Container structure or initiating warp during an active hack.
zh: 你的病毒连贯性降到 0
破解窗口因任何原因被关闭，例如离容器建筑太远，或在破解过程中开始跃迁。

blocks.en: If you fail the hack:
blocks.zh: 破解失败后：

en: twice, a Data or Relic Site Container structure will be destroyed (with a few exceptions, such as the Storage Depots in Sleeper Caches)
once, a Covert Research Facility Container structure will be destroyed and deal a large amount of explosive damage to all ships in range
once, a Sleeper Cache will release a deadly toxic gas, activate turrets or put up other obstacle. Specific information can be found on the respective Sleeper Cache pages.
once, any hackable container in the Observatory Infiltration site will activate lockdown
once, the AEGIS Encrypted Key Storage will spawn a hostile response fleet.
zh: 失败两次，数据或遗迹站点的容器建筑会被摧毁（少数例外，如冬眠者储藏点中的储存仓库）
失败一次，秘密研究设施的容器建筑会被摧毁，并对范围内所有舰船造成大量爆炸伤害
失败一次，冬眠者储藏点会释放致命毒气、激活炮塔或设置其他障碍。具体信息请见各冬眠者储藏点的页面。
失败一次，观测站渗透站点中的任何可破解容器都会触发封锁
失败一次，AEGIS 加密密钥储存库会刷出一支敌对响应舰队。

blocks.en: Defensive Subsystems
blocks.zh: 防御子系统

blocks.en: Defensive Subsystems prevent you from exploring adjacent nodes until they are disabled.
blocks.zh: 防御子系统在被瘫痪之前，会阻止你探索与之相邻的节点。

en: Firewalls have high Coherence and low Strength.
Anti-Virus have low Coherence, but high Strength.
Restoration Nodes give 20 extra Coherence to a random Defensive Subsystem at the end of each turn (though never to the System Core). They are a high priority target.
Virus Suppressors lower your Virus Strength by 15. Your Virus Strength cannot go below 10. They are a high priority target.
zh: 防火墙连贯性高、强度低。
杀毒软件连贯性低，但强度高。
恢复节点会在每回合结束时给一个随机的防御子系统恢复 20 点连贯性（但不会给系统核心）。应优先消灭。
病毒抑制器会让你的病毒强度降低 15。病毒强度最低不会低于 10。应优先消灭。

blocks.en: Utility Subsystems
blocks.zh: 功能子系统

blocks.en: Utility Subsystems assist you in disabling the System Core and Defensive Subsystems.
blocks.zh: 功能子系统可以帮你瘫痪系统核心和防御子系统。

blocks.en: When you click the Utility Subsystem it will be added to a free utility slot.
blocks.zh: 点击功能子系统后，它会被放入一个空闲的功能栏位。

blocks.en: Activate the Utility Subsystem by clicking on it in your utility belt. They can also be activated by pressing the number keys "1", "2" etc. The number of utility belt slots depends on your Analyzer module.
blocks.zh: 在功能栏中点击功能子系统即可激活，也可以按数字键“1”“2”等激活。功能栏位的数量取决于你的分析仪装备。

en: Self Repairs increase your Virus Coherence by 5-10 each turn for the three turns. Use it immediately as your Virus doesn't have a maximum Coherence value. Appears in all categories of hacking difficulty.
Kernel Rots reduce a System’s Coherence by 50%. Use it on high Coherence Systems.
Polymorphic Shields nullify the next two System attacks against your Virus. Use it before attacking high Strength Systems.
Secondary Vectors reduce a System’s Coherence by 20 each turn for three turns. Use it against a Suppressor Defensive Subsystem.
zh: 自我修复在三个回合内每回合为你的病毒恢复 5-10 点连贯性。拿到后立即使用，因为病毒的连贯性没有上限。所有难度的破解中都会出现。
内核腐蚀使目标系统的连贯性降低 50%。对高连贯性的系统使用。
多态护盾抵消接下来两次系统对你病毒的攻击。在攻击高强度系统之前使用。
二级载体在三个回合内每回合使目标系统的连贯性降低 20。对抑制器类防御子系统使用。

blocks.en: Self Repairs appears in all categories of hacking difficulty.
blocks.zh: 自我修复在所有难度的破解中都会出现。

blocks.en: Kernel Rot only appears in Very Easy and Easy hacks by chance from opening Data Caches, and naturally appears in Medium hacking difficulty and up.
blocks.zh: 内核腐蚀在非常简单和简单难度中只会在打开数据缓存时随机出现，中等及以上难度则会自然出现。

blocks.en: Polymorphic Shield appears in Medium hacking difficulty and up.
blocks.zh: 多态护盾在中等及以上难度中出现。

blocks.en: Secondary Vector appears in Hard hacking difficulty and up.
blocks.zh: 二级载体在困难及以上难度中出现。

blocks.en: Data Caches
blocks.zh: 数据缓存

en: Data Caches can contain either a Defensive or Utility Subsystem.
zh: 数据缓存里可能是防御子系统，也可能是功能子系统。

blocks.en: Data Caches have a 50-50 probability of containing a Defensive or a Utility Subsystem.
blocks.zh: 数据缓存里是防御子系统还是功能子系统，概率各占 50%。

blocks.en: Open a Data Cache by clicking on it. Open them only as a last resort.
blocks.zh: 点击数据缓存即可打开。不到万不得已不要打开。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

en: Archaeology (3x, 250k ISK): Required skill for the use of Relic Analyzer modules. Gives +10 Virus Coherence per level.

Relic Analyzers require Archaeology, and are a fairly cheap mid-slot module used to interact with Container structures. A good amount of your income as an explorer will come from accessing these Container structures, so note this skill's importance!

Higher skill levels makes hacking Relic Site Container structures easier, with Archaeology V allowing you to use the powerful Relic Analyzer II module. Explorers should considering training Archaeology to V, especially if they intend to hack Relic Sites in NullSec or Wormholes.
Hacking (3x, 250k ISK): Required skill for the use of Data Analyzer modules. Gives +10 Virus Coherence per level.

A la Archaeology, Data Analyzers require Hacking, and open Container structures found in Data Sites, Chemical Labs and Ghost Sites. Hacking I has slightly higher requirements than Archaeology I, but make sure you get both skills, so that you can hack any sites you find.

Also like Archaeology, higher skill levels make hacking easier, and Hacking V will give you access to the Data Analyzer II module, which gives better bonuses, and is needed for Data Sites in NullSec or Wormholes.
zh: 考古学（3 倍训练时间，250k ISK）：使用遗迹分析仪装备的前置技能。每级 +10 病毒连贯性。
遗迹分析仪需要考古学技能，是一种相当便宜的中槽装备，用来和容器建筑交互。作为探索者，你相当一部分收入都来自打开这些容器建筑，所以要重视这个技能！
技能等级越高，破解遗迹站点的容器建筑就越容易；考古学 V可以让你使用强力的遗迹分析仪 II。探索者应考虑把考古学练到 V，尤其是打算在00 区或虫洞破解遗迹站点的话。
电脑破译原理（3 倍训练时间，250k ISK）：使用数据分析仪装备的前置技能。每级 +10 病毒连贯性。
和考古学类似，数据分析仪需要电脑破译原理技能，用于打开数据站点、化学实验室和幽灵站点中的容器建筑。电脑破译原理 I的前置要求比考古学 I 稍高，但两个技能都要练，这样你遇到的任何站点都能破解。
同样和考古学一样，技能等级越高破解越容易；电脑破译原理 V可以让你使用数据分析仪 II，它的加成更好，而且是破解 00 区或虫洞数据站点所必需的。

blocks.en: Ships and equipment
blocks.zh: 舰船与装备

blocks.en: Ships
blocks.zh: 舰船

blocks.en: Hacking can be done in any ship that has mid slots for Data and/or Relic Analyzers. However, exploration ships have a role bonus for both Virus and scan Strength.
blocks.zh: 任何有中槽可以装数据分析仪和/或遗迹分析仪的舰船都能进行破解。不过探索舰船对病毒强度和扫描强度都有特有加成。

blocks.en: Each Empire's Tech 1 Exploration Frigate has a role bonus of +5 Virus Strength to both Data and Relic Analyzers. These ships also get an 7.5% (37.5% max) increase to scan strength per racial frigate level, which helps in scanning down Cosmic Signatures. The Navy Exploration frigate is a small upgrade with more defense and movement speed at the tradeoff of greater cost.
blocks.zh: 各帝国的 T1 探索护卫舰都有特有加成：数据分析仪和遗迹分析仪的病毒强度 +5。这些舰船每级对应种族护卫舰技能还提供 7.5%（最高 37.5%）的扫描强度加成，有助于扫出宇宙信号。海军型探索护卫舰是小幅升级版，防御和航速更高，代价是价格更贵。

blocks.en: Ship equipment
blocks.zh: 舰船装备

blocks.en: Data Analyzer or Relic Analyzer allow you to hack Data and Relic Sites. There is no additional high, mid or low slot equipment to make hacking easier.
blocks.zh: 数据分析仪或遗迹分析仪可以让你破解数据和遗迹站点。没有其他高槽、中槽或低槽装备能让破解变得更容易。

blocks.en: Full list of normally used scanning equipment:
blocks.zh: 常用扫描装备的完整列表：

en: Data Analyzers are used to hack Data and Chemical Lab sites found while exploring. The T1 module has a base 40 Virus Coherence and 20 Strength, with the T2 Version has an additional +20 Virus Coherence (60 total) and +10 Virus Strength (30 total)

Relic Analyzers are only used to hack Relic Sites The T1 module has a base 40 Virus Coherence and 20 Strength, with the T2 Version has an additional +20 Virus Coherence (60 total) and +10 Virus Strength (30 total)

Integrated Analyzers are modules that can hack both Data and Relic sites. They are more expensive then their specialized counterparts, have lower Virus Coherence and Strength, and smaller utility belt slots. Integrated Analyzers get bonus Coherence from both Archaeology and Hacking skills as well as rigs and implants.

Memetic Algorithm Bank rig increases the Virus Coherence of both Data and Integrated Analyzers. The T1 rig increases the Coherence by +10, and the T2 version increases it by +20. Due to Calibration size and ISK cost, it is more cost-effective to have two T1 rigs than one T2 rig.

Emission Scope Sharpener rig increases the Virus Coherence of both Relic and Integrated Analyzers. The T1 rig increases the Coherence by +10, and the T2 version increases it by +20. Due to Calibration size and ISK cost, it is more cost-effective to have two T1 rigs than one T2 rig.
zh: 数据分析仪用于破解探索时发现的数据站点和化学实验室站点。T1 型号基础病毒连贯性为 40、强度为 20，T2 型号额外 +20 病毒连贯性（共 60）和 +10 病毒强度（共 30）
遗迹分析仪只用于破解遗迹站点。T1 型号基础病毒连贯性为 40、强度为 20，T2 型号额外 +20 病毒连贯性（共 60）和 +10 病毒强度（共 30）
集成式分析仪是可以同时破解数据和遗迹站点的装备。它们比专用分析仪更贵，病毒连贯性和强度更低，功能栏位也更少。集成式分析仪能同时从考古学和电脑破译原理技能，以及改装件和植入体获得连贯性加成。
弥集进化演算法数据库改装件可以提高数据分析仪和集成式分析仪的病毒连贯性。T1 改装件提高 +10 连贯性，T2 型号提高 +20。考虑到校准值和 ISK 成本，装两个 T1 改装件比装一个 T2 更划算。
放射范围约束装置改装件可以提高遗迹分析仪和集成式分析仪的病毒连贯性。T1 改装件提高 +10 连贯性，T2 型号提高 +20。考虑到校准值和 ISK 成本，装两个 T1 改装件比装一个 T2 更划算。

blocks.en: Tips and Tricks
blocks.zh: 技巧与窍门

en: Explore the board as much as possible before attacking a Defensive Subsystem. You may just stumble onto the System Core early! Restoration Nodes and Virus Suppressors are the exception to this though, as they should be removed from the board as soon as possible.
Always pick up Utility Subsystems as soon as they are exposed. If you keep exploring without snagging these, a Defensive Subsystem might pop up and cut off your access to them!

Be careful of where you are clicking. It is quite common for one to blitz through a site and unintentionally discover the System Core or a Utility Subsystem, only to then click on another node to reveal a Defensive Subsystem, blocking off access to it. Rush only when you are certain that what you need is unlikely to spawn on that area of the grid.

The utility subsystem 'Secondary Vector' can be used to clear Virus Suppressors and Antiviruses from the board without sustaining damage, as such it is advised to hold on to them unless there is no other option.
Always use a Self Repair as soon as you find it. It increases your Virus Coherence, so there is no gain in waiting.
Don’t open Data Caches until you’ve fully explored all their adjacent nodes. You don’t want your exploration to be cut off by an unexpected Defensive Subsystem!
Difficult hack's Data Caches might expose Restoration Nodes and Suppressors. Leave opening Data Caches as a last resort.
On this note, if you are low on coherence and have already discovered the System Core, opening Data Caches is completely safe assuming:
1. The Data Cache is NOT adjacent to the System Core, as revealing a Defensive Subsystem here will block off the System Core and almost certainly render the hack forfeit.

2. The hack being attempted is NOT a red core (Hard) hack. In yellow (Medium) hacks and below, none of the Defensive Subsystems will directly affect your ability to destroy the System Core, as Restoration Nodes cannot heal the System Core. On a Hard hack, it can risk spawning Virus Suppressors, which will reduce your virus strength and possibly fail the hack. However, if one feels that the risk is worth it, by all means, go ahead.

Use the 1-5 numbers to guide your movement around the board. For example, if you're approaching an edge or corner of the grid, and the number 5 shows up, then trying to explore anything towards that corner/edge is not useful, because you know that there cannot be anything good within 5 nodes. In general, you want to click in directions that make the numbers smaller. Because the numbers disappear as you move along, you need to remember where there were 5's, so you know which areas not to bother going back to later.

Use the Rule of Six. This rule is slightly complicated, but can make your life when hacking much easier. The rule is that if you have a node that has six edges leading away from it ( a "complete" node with no missing nodes in the hexagon around it), then that node is guaranteed to 1) Have no Defensive Subsystems in it OR 2) be adjacent to the System Core. What that means in practice is that you can use these squares to move safely through the board, and any Defensive Subsystems you find tell you where the System Core is. It is usually worthwhile to try to reach and use areas of the map with many of these "complete" nodes when hacking. You can find a video tutorial here.

Rule of 8, or "Before 8 it's Bait". The core is always placed at least 8 grid-spaces (including empty spaces) away from the starting point. If such placement is impossible, the core is placed randomly anywhere on the board.
zh: 在攻击防御子系统之前，尽可能多地探索棋盘。说不定你很早就碰上系统核心了！不过恢复节点和病毒抑制器是例外，应该尽快把它们清除掉。
功能子系统一露面就立刻拿走。如果不拿就继续探索，可能会冒出一个防御子系统挡住你拿它们的路！
点之前看清楚。常有人一路狂点，无意中发现了系统核心或功能子系统，接着又点开另一个节点，冒出一个防御子系统把路堵死。只有确定那片区域不太可能刷出你需要的东西时，才可以快速推进。
功能子系统“二级载体”可以在不受伤害的情况下清除病毒抑制器和杀毒软件，所以除非别无选择，建议留着它。
自我修复一拿到就立即使用。它会增加你的病毒连贯性，留着没有任何好处。
在完全探索数据缓存周围的所有相邻节点之前，不要打开它。你可不想被意外冒出的防御子系统挡住探索路线！
高难度破解中的数据缓存可能会放出恢复节点和抑制器。打开数据缓存要留作最后手段。
顺带一提，如果你的连贯性不多了，而且已经找到了系统核心，那么在以下前提下打开数据缓存是完全安全的：
1. 该数据缓存不与系统核心相邻，因为在这里冒出防御子系统会挡住系统核心，几乎必然导致破解失败。
2. 当前破解不是红色核心（困难）难度。在黄色（中等）及以下难度中，没有任何防御子系统会直接影响你摧毁系统核心，因为恢复节点无法治疗系统核心。而在困难难度中，有可能刷出病毒抑制器，降低你的病毒强度并可能导致破解失败。不过如果你觉得值得冒这个险，尽管去做。
利用数字 1-5 来指引你在棋盘上的移动。比如你正靠近棋盘的边缘或角落，而这时出现了数字 5，那么再往那个角落/边缘探索就没有意义了，因为你知道 5 个节点内不可能有好东西。总的来说，要往让数字变小的方向点。由于数字会随着你的移动消失，你需要记住哪里出现过 5，这样就知道以后哪些区域不必回头去探索。
运用“六边规则”。这条规则稍微复杂，但能让你的破解轻松很多。规则是：如果一个节点有六条边通向外面（一个“完整”节点，周围六边形中没有缺失的节点），那么这个节点必定 1）里面没有防御子系统，或者 2）与系统核心相邻。实际意义是，你可以利用这些格子在棋盘上安全移动，而你发现的任何防御子系统都能告诉你系统核心在哪。破解时，尽量到达并利用地图上有很多这种“完整”节点的区域，通常是值得的。视频教程见这里。
“八格规则”，即“八格之内皆是诱饵”。系统核心总是被放在离起点至少 8 格（包括空格）的位置。如果无法这样放置，核心就会被随机放在棋盘的任意位置。

blocks.zh: 八格规则的最简形式
